title: Atlas Assembly v1
description: Structural schema for an AtlasAssembly record. The current backend's GeneratedModel dataclass (backend/jewelmind/geometry/model.py) is the CURRENT implementation this generalizes. See docs/bible/07-atlas/131-assembly-contract.md.

assemblyId.description: e.g. "solitaire" — the only assembly type that currently exists.

requiredComponents.description: CURRENT: ["band", "stone_reference", "prongs", "basket_support"] — all four are always attempted; none is optional today.

optionalComponents.description: CURRENT: none. No optional component exists in the solitaire assembly.

transformOwnership.description: PLANNED — no explicit transform-ownership model exists; every component builder computes its own absolute placement directly from JDL-derived constants (inner_radius, outer_radius, band_top_z, prong_center_radius), not from a parent-assembly-owned transform. See docs/bible/07-atlas/125-transformations.md.

aggregateBoundingBox.description: CURRENT: GeneratedModel.bounding_box, the union of combined_metal's bbox and stone_reference's bbox.

totalProductionMetalVolume.description: CURRENT: GeneratedModel.combined_metal_volume_mm3 — excludes stone_reference by definition.
